chapters.title: Benjamin Teaches His Sons
chapters.synopsis: Aging King Benjamin teaches his sons the language and prophecies of their fathers, stressing that the brass plates preserved their faith. He charges his son Mosiah to gather the people so he can give them a name and announce his successor.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Benjamin teaches his sons from the records

segments.speaker: benjamin
segments.note: Benjamin charges Mosiah to gather the people

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Mosiah receives the kingdom and the records

chapters.title: In the Service of Your God
chapters.synopsis: Families gather in tents around the temple, and Benjamin speaks from a tower. He recounts his service as king, teaches that serving others is serving God, and warns against rebellion, calling all to obedience and gratitude.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: The people gather at the temple

segments.speaker: benjamin
segments.note: Benjamin on service, indebtedness, and obedience

chapters.title: The Angel Foretells Christ
chapters.synopsis: Benjamin relates the words an angel spoke to him: Jesus Christ will come, work miracles, suffer, and atone for sin. The angel teaches that the natural man is an enemy to God and must yield to the Holy Spirit through Christ's atonement.

segments.speaker: benjamin
segments.note: Benjamin continues his address

segments.speaker: angel
segments.note: The angel's prophecy of Christ's ministry and atonement

chapters.title: Retain a Remission of Sins
chapters.synopsis: Overcome by Benjamin's words, the multitude falls to the earth and receives a remission of sins. Benjamin teaches them to remember God's goodness, care for the poor, watch their thoughts and deeds, and so retain that remission.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: The people cry for mercy and are filled with joy

segments.speaker: benjamin
segments.note: Believe in God, impart to the poor, watch yourselves

chapters.title: Children of Christ
chapters.synopsis: The people declare a mighty change of heart and covenant to obey God. Benjamin gives them the name of Christ, teaching that through covenant they become His sons and daughters and must remain steadfast to be sealed His.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Benjamin asks the people to answer

segments.speaker: multitude
segments.note: The people declare their covenant and changed hearts

segments.speaker: benjamin
segments.note: Take upon you the name of Christ

chapters.title: Mosiah Begins His Reign
chapters.synopsis: Benjamin records the names of all who entered the covenant and consecrates Mosiah as king. Three years later Benjamin dies, and Mosiah reigns in righteousness, laboring with his own hands as his father did.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Mosiah consecrated king; Benjamin dies

chapters.title: Ammon Finds the People of Limhi
chapters.synopsis: Mosiah sends Ammon and fifteen men to learn the fate of those who left for the land of Nephi. Ammon finds King Limhi's people in bondage to the Lamanites, and Limhi rejoices, telling his people deliverance is near if they turn to God.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Ammon's expedition finds Limhi's people

segments.speaker: limhi
segments.note: Limhi recounts their bondage and urges trust in God

chapters.title: A Seer Is Greater Than a Prophet
chapters.synopsis: Limhi tells Ammon of a lost expedition that found twenty-four gold plates among the ruins of a destroyed people. Ammon explains that King Mosiah is a seer who can translate them, and teaches that a seer's gift is greater than a prophet's.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Limhi shares his people's records with Ammon

segments.speaker: limhi
segments.note: Limhi tells of the twenty-four gold plates

segments.speaker: ammon1
segments.note: Ammon explains seers, revelators, and translation

chapters.title: Zeniff Reclaims the Land of Nephi
chapters.synopsis: Zeniff begins his own record: over-zealous to inherit the land of his fathers, he leads a colony back to the land of Nephi and covenants with King Laman for possession of two cities. The Lamanite king's hidden design is to bring them into bondage, and war soon follows, but Zeniff's people drive off the attack in God's strength.

segments.speaker: zeniff
segments.note: Zeniff's first-person record of the colony

chapters.title: Zeniff Arms His People
chapters.synopsis: Zeniff sets guards and prepares weapons, and his people prosper for over twenty years. He explains the Lamanites' inherited traditions of hatred toward Nephi's descendants, then leads his people to victory in another battle before conferring the kingdom on his son Noah.

segments.speaker: zeniff
segments.note: Zeniff on Lamanite traditions and the second war

chapters.title: King Noah's Wicked Reign
chapters.synopsis: Noah replaces his father's priests with flatterers, taxes the people a fifth of all they own, and leads them into pride and immorality. The prophet Abinadi warns that bondage awaits unless they repent, and Noah seeks his life.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Noah's riotous reign and heavy taxes

segments.speaker: abinadi
segments.note: Abinadi delivers the Lord's warning of bondage

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Noah seeks to slay Abinadi

chapters.title: Abinadi Is Brought Before Noah
chapters.synopsis: After two years Abinadi returns in disguise and prophesies destruction, famine, and bondage. The people bind him and deliver him to King Noah, whose priests try to cross him with scripture; Abinadi rebukes them for teaching what they do not live and recites the commandments.

segments.speaker: abinadi
segments.note: Abinadi prophesies destruction upon this generation

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Abinadi arraigned; the priests question him

segments.speaker: abinadi
segments.note: Abinadi rebukes the priests and begins the commandments

chapters.title: Abinadi Recites the Commandments
chapters.synopsis: When Noah orders him seized, Abinadi is protected by divine power and his face shines as he finishes delivering the Ten Commandments. He teaches that salvation does not come by the law of Moses alone, for the law points forward to the redemption of God.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Noah orders Abinadi taken

segments.speaker: abinadi
segments.note: The commandments; the law points to Christ

chapters.title: The Suffering Servant
chapters.synopsis: Abinadi recites Isaiah's prophecy of the Messiah: a man of sorrows, despised and rejected, wounded for our transgressions. Like a lamb led to slaughter, he bears the iniquities of all and makes his soul an offering for sin.

segments.speaker: isaiah
segments.note: Abinadi quotes Isaiah on the suffering Messiah

chapters.title: God Himself Shall Redeem His People
chapters.synopsis: Abinadi teaches how Christ is both the Father and the Son, subjecting the flesh to the will of the Spirit. He explains who Christ's seed are, declares how beautiful are the feet of those who publish peace, and testifies of resurrection and redemption.

segments.speaker: abinadi
segments.note: Christ as Father and Son; the first resurrection

chapters.title: Redemption Through Christ
chapters.synopsis: Abinadi concludes his defense: all mankind is lost and fallen except they rely on Christ, who breaks the bands of death. The wicked remain as though there were no redemption, while the righteous rise to endless life and happiness.

segments.speaker: abinadi
segments.note: The fall, redemption, and final judgment

chapters.title: Abinadi Seals His Testimony
chapters.synopsis: The young priest Alma believes Abinadi, pleads for him, and is cast out; he hides and writes Abinadi's words. Noah condemns Abinadi to death by fire, and the prophet prophesies that Noah will suffer the same fate before sealing his testimony with his life.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Alma believes; Noah condemns Abinadi

segments.speaker: abinadi
segments.note: Abinadi's final prophecy against Noah's people

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Abinadi suffers death by fire

chapters.title: Covenant at the Waters of Mormon
chapters.synopsis: Alma teaches Abinadi's words privately and gathers believers at the waters of Mormon. He invites them to bear one another's burdens and stand as witnesses of God, baptizes about two hundred souls, and organizes the church of Christ before Noah's army drives them into the wilderness.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Alma gathers believers at the waters of Mormon

segments.speaker: alma1
segments.note: The baptismal covenant: mourn with those that mourn

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Baptisms, church order, and escape from Noah

chapters.title: The Death of King Noah
chapters.synopsis: Gideon rises against King Noah, but a Lamanite invasion interrupts them. Noah orders the men to abandon their families and flee; his own followers later burn him alive, fulfilling Abinadi's words, and his son Limhi rules under tribute to the Lamanites.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Noah burned; Limhi reigns under tribute

chapters.title: The Stolen Daughters of the Lamanites
chapters.synopsis: Noah's fugitive priests abduct twenty-four Lamanite daughters, and the Lamanite king wrongly blames Limhi's people and attacks. Limhi's people fight desperately and capture the wounded king; Gideon discerns the priests' guilt, and the king pacifies his army.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: The abduction, the battle, and peace restored

chapters.title: Bondage in the Land of Nephi
chapters.synopsis: The Lamanites smite and burden Limhi's people, who are driven three times in battle before they humble themselves. The Lord softens their bondage as they cry to Him, and when Ammon arrives Limhi rejoices, for a path of deliverance is opening.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Defeats, humbling, and the hope Ammon brings

chapters.title: Limhi's People Escape
chapters.synopsis: Gideon proposes sending the Lamanite guards a tribute of wine, and while the guards lie drunken the whole people slip out a secret pass by night. They journey to Zarahemla, where Mosiah receives them with joy, while a Lamanite army loses their trail in the wilderness.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: The wine stratagem and flight to Zarahemla

chapters.title: Alma's People in the Land of Helam
chapters.synopsis: Alma's people build the city of Helam and prosper, and Alma refuses to be a king, teaching that they should trust no man to reign in unrighteousness. A Lamanite army led by Amulon, chief of Noah's old priests, finds them and sets taskmasters over them.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Helam built; Amulon brings Alma's people into bondage

chapters.title: Delivered Out of Bondage
chapters.synopsis: Amulon persecutes Alma's people and forbids them to pray aloud, but they pour out their hearts silently. The Lord eases their burdens until they carry them with cheer, then causes a deep sleep to fall on their guards, and the people escape to Zarahemla.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Amulon's persecution; silent prayers

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The Lord covenants to ease their burdens

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Burdens made light; escape to Zarahemla

chapters.title: One People in Zarahemla
chapters.synopsis: Mosiah gathers the people and reads the records of Zeniff and of Alma, filling them with wonder, sorrow, and gratitude. Limhi and his people are baptized, and Alma organizes churches throughout the land with authority from God.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: The records read; churches established across Zarahemla

chapters.title: Whosoever Repents Shall Be Forgiven
chapters.synopsis: A rising generation refuses to believe, and unbelievers ensnare church members with flattery. Troubled over how to judge transgressors, Alma inquires of the Lord, who declares that He will forgive all who truly repent, while the unrepentant are to be blotted out of the church.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Unbelief spreads; Alma inquires of the Lord

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The Lord teaches how to judge transgressors

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Alma regulates the church in righteousness

chapters.title: An Angel Stops Alma the Younger
chapters.synopsis: Alma the Younger and the sons of Mosiah secretly seek to destroy the church until an angel appears with a voice of thunder, calling Alma to repentance. Struck dumb and helpless, Alma awakens after two days declaring he has been born of the Spirit, and the young men spend their days repairing the harm they caused.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Persecution forbidden; the rebels confronted

segments.speaker: angel
segments.note: The angel commands Alma to stop destroying the church

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Alma struck dumb; fasting and prayer

segments.speaker: alma2
segments.note: Alma testifies he is born of the Spirit

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: The converted young men strengthen the church

chapters.title: The Sons of Mosiah Choose a Mission
chapters.synopsis: The sons of Mosiah beg leave to preach to the Lamanites, unable to bear that any soul should perish, and the Lord promises Mosiah their safety. Mosiah, with no son to take the throne, translates the twenty-four gold plates and confers all the records on Alma the Younger.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: The mission granted; the records conferred on Alma

chapters.title: The Reign of the Judges Begins
chapters.synopsis: Mosiah proposes that judges chosen by the voice of the people replace kings, warning how much wickedness one unrighteous king can cause. The people gladly accept, Alma the Younger becomes the first chief judge, and both Mosiah and Alma the Elder die that same year.

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: The people ask Aaron to be king

segments.speaker: mosiah2
segments.note: Mosiah's written counsel for a reign of judges

segments.speaker: mormon
segments.note: Judges chosen; Mosiah and Alma the Elder die
